digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter value maps and boundary guards
propositions: Two identical copies of the ticket-type map literal exist under adapters/ (Cloud and DC backends), creating silent divergence risk for issue-type creation
The one-literal guard protecting status and priority maps does not cover the ticket-type map, leaving room for a third copy to go undetected
The ticket-type map must be relocated to adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and imported under the _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE alias by both create paths, following the J2 precedent for dual-deployment maps

External test consumer at test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py reads the name as a module attribute on outbound_fields, requiring absolute import binding strategy to keep module-level access resolvable
The boundary guard must be extended with test_exactly_one_type_map_literal_within_adapters to fail the build if a second literal is reintroduced
